Appearance:
 Shri Manish Datt, Sr. Counsel with Shri Rakesh Dwived
 for the applicant.

Shri Anuj Singh - P.L. appearing for State.
 Order
This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2. The applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.367 of 2025 registered at P.S. Mauganj, District- Mauganj, M.P. for the offence punishable under sections 420 of IPC.

3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant executed an agreement to sale in favour of complainant on 15.7.2024 (Annexure A/3) but later on, it came to know that applicant was not owner of the land and it had been given on lease but lease was canceled prior to execution of aforesaid agreement to sale.
4. Learned Sr. counsel for the applicant submits that present case pertains to non-compliance of agreement to sale.
It is a case of civil in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37217 2 MCRC-25920-2025 nature, which has been given colour of criminal case.
Complainant ought to have filed suit for specific performance.
It is also urged that no documents have been filed along with complaint to show that land belong to Government and it was given on lease.
Learned senior counsel further submits that there were no dues to bank over the land.

On above grounds, it is urged Bharat Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24230086/

sentences.text: that applicant be released on anticipatory bail.
5. Learned Counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.

6. This Court has examined the submission of learned senior counsel for the applicant in the light of documents available in the case diary and in view of documentary evidence available in the case diary, at this stage, with respect to land being Government land and lease having been canceled prior to execution of agreement to sale, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7. It is directed that in the event of his arrest, applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer.

It is also directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023.

It is made clear that applicant shall appear before the Investigating Officer as & when he is so directed and cooperate with the investigation and he shall also appear before the Trial Court failing which his bail shall automatically stand cancelled without further reference to the Court.
